title: Aspen Search halftone window
description: A media tile that, when empty, shows a fine ink dot screen fixed to the browser window, so several tiles read as holes onto one still halftone layer behind a scrolling grid.
notes: placeholder for the original's fixed WebGL halftone scene; pass media to fill it with a real image, video or canvas
the dots use background-attachment: fixed (iOS Safari scrolls them instead)
name: aspensearch-halftone

props.name: media
props.description: what fills the window: an image, a video, a canvas… Empty: a placeholder dot screen

props.name: className
props.description: sizing and placement (the window takes the size it's given)
